notes.title: 🧼"The Big Wash"💰 Update is here!
notes.notes: [h1]Hey there, Cleaners![/h1][p][/p][p]Today we are releasing our second major content update -[b]🧼"The Big Wash"💰 update! Yay![/b][/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who tested on the Experimental Branch. Your reports and suggestions helped us tune balance, fix issues, and polish the new systems for this release.[/p][p]If you enjoy the update, please consider leaving a Steam review. It really helps! You can also share feedback on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/eFGKbX8PM7"]Discord[/url] and on the [url="https://cashcleanersimulator.featureupvote.com/"]UpVote Board[/url].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ETzndeJEx2s;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]🚀All the features planned for this update are done🚀[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/a596b62c2a42c95ba955eb45426bae0692b5cc09.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1][h3]🔧 Key Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The new [b]Industrial Washing Machine:[/b] it removes any type of dirt using one of three special chemicals (Detergents) and can be used like a regular washer. Check the usage guide printed on the top panel. Don’t forget a coin to pay for a run.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/738ebcf02373deda65a84a5f8768c8caae7f2b91.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]It can also wash dirty containers. Remember to dry them after washing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/73d24ba332e118791f4d878ecf64f6147eb5afbf.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added new consumables for the Industrial Washing Machine called [b]Detergents[/b], used to clean different types of dirt. Pour a Detergent into the dedicated slot and watch it work.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/2543898747b919eab1b8353dbae8a69a3e83a98c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]New consumable for the [b]Workbench[/b] called [b]Foam Sprayer[/b]. Three types are available depending on what you want to clean. The foam can dissipate and clean items automatically, or you can use a [b]Sponge[/b] to speed it up. Once delivered it appears at the Workbench and can be refilled.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/820bddca024cf5c6ba0214eca4fa79d5f216d466.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]You can wash [b]marked money[/b] with a [b]Foam Sprayer[/b] at the Workbench or with a [b]Detergent[/b] in the Industrial Washing Machine.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/2c27ab1b4ef17d0e1370b2a4c0b95e53988a5576.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]A new chemical dirt type called [b]Goo[/b]. To clean it, you need the [b]anti-Goo Detergent[/b] or [b]Foam[/b]. It is very rare and starts appearing after level 17.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/ab2e088ef22e10673d6565900e64ba1d16e7d64b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sponge[/b] is now a consumable. You can buy extras. It wears down in stages and is available from the very start at the Workbench.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/e49ff498976eafbbceac546775260f7b7400519d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added a new rare Container type called [b]Barrel[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/07ebff54d7b657045ee2d6cca51ec9d996da266b.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Other minor changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]hotkey V[/b] to close the [b]Scanner[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals for the [b]Shopping Cart[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Set the [b]Workbench[/b] to a new position and a new startup loadout when starting a new game (for smoother progression for new players).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few [b]more sounds[/b] and general audio improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to the [b]Quest Generator[/b] [b]system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added some optimizations for the [b]Workbench[/b] when handling large amounts of money.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized [b]coin visuals[/b] and introduced new [b]coin icons[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed visuals for some types of containers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some random issues where the Scanner showed false information about object status (dirty, inked, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some physics issues for Money Counters.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor optimizations for in-game 3D content.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations for performance when many Money Sorters are on screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a burning issue with the Furnace.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor localization and UI fixes in FR, RU, ES.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Scanner and Phone could be open simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where empty containers displayed money and items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect color display for containers.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for every Wishlist, bug report, and idea. Have fun with 'The Big Wash'![/p][p][/p][p][i]– The Cash Cleaner Team [/i]💸[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p align="start"]Another Forklift-published game still has its demo up. An improved version is already in the works. It might be your thing 👇🏻[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571710/Leaf_Blower_Co/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: [Experimental] Update 1.2.1.323 Now Live!
notes.notes: [h2]🚧 Experimental Branch Update – Try at Your Own Risk![/h2][p][/p][h3]Hello Cleaners![/h3][p]We want to thank you for all the feedback after our last update. It has been incredibly valuable and helped us shape a set of adjustments and improvements that now need testing.[/p][p]If everything works as intended, we plan to move this update to the main branch next week so everyone can enjoy the new features.[/p][p]👇🏻 Jump in, try out the build, and let us know your thoughts on [url="https://discord.gg/5g3kZ28pG8"]Discord [/url]or right here in the comments. We’ll be reading everything, and your feedback helps us keep polishing the game![/p][p][/p][p]⚠️Please note that it may be unstable. Make sure to back up your save files before playing and proceed at your own risk⚠️[/p][p][/p][h2]🔧 Key Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Sponge is now consumable. You can buy extras, it has multiple stages, and it is available from the very start on the Workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new rare Container type: [b]Barrel[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added hotkey [b]V[/b] to close the scanner.[/p][/*][*][p]Added original sounds for the [b]Industrial Washing Machine[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h2]🧽 Other Minor Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Minor adjustments to the [b]Quests Generator[/b] system.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated sounds for the [b]Foam Sprayer[/b] on the Workbench and the [b]Detergent Canister[/b] for the Industrial Washing Machine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Foam[/b] and [b]Detergent[/b] for cleaning marks are now much more expensive.[/p][/*][*][p]Plus optimizations for the [b]Workbench[/b] when handling large amounts of money.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals and UX for the [b]Industrial Washing Machine[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added icons for [b]Detergent Canisters[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added new [b]Coins[/b] icons.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed [b]coins visuals[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations for performance when many [b]Money Sorters[/b] are on screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where part of the money in the [b]Washing Machine[/b] was not being washed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed burning issue with the [b]Furnace[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Minor localization fixes in [b]FR, RU, ES[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where [b]Scanner[/b] and [b]Phone[/b] could be open simultaneously.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor [b]money counter UI[/b] issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Travel Bag[/b] state when full of money.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple positioning issues with [b]Detergent Canisters[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where empty containers displayed money and items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect color display for containers.[/p][/*][*][p]Various small UI fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🔊 Known Issue[/h2][p]We’re aware of a sound bug with Detergent Canisters: if you pick one up while it’s playing its bubbling sound, the effect can get stuck and follow you around. Reloading your save will stop it. This won’t be fixed in today’s update, but a patch is planned.[/p][hr][/hr][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2488370/view/515218419125060615"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🔧 QoL Update 1.1.1.185 is here!
notes.notes: [h1]Hey there, Cleaners![/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a new update for Cash Cleaner Simulator. As always, it includes fixes, improvements, and some extra polish based on your feedback. Scroll down for the full patch notes.[/p][p]Thanks to your reports and suggestions, we’ve made several tweaks and improvements across the game. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h2]🔧 Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added more options of Screen resolution in the Graphics Settings menu[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/3db66c95a258a67b2a4c31fcb74af0234d5b4c92.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Updated some counting machine sounds according to your feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly improved work of Task Tracker, especially for the end game[/p][/*][*][p]Added multiple Localization improvements for all languages[/p][/*][*][p]Completed Quests data save optimisations[/p][/*][/list][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed rare late game crash on multiple objects on the game level[/p][/*][*][p]Add localisation for Save Game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization for Settings App in the Smartphone[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🔜 Roadmap update[/h2][p]To keep things flowing smoothly, we’ve made a small tweak to the roadmap. One of the future updates has been split into two, which means we now have six updates planned instead of five.[/p][p]Right now we’re focused on Update 2, and there are no changes to its timing. It’s still on track for release in the [b]second half of August[/b], once we’re back from a short summer break during the first two weeks of the month.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/87fcab0874e08a7806bafae9a01e2741ea45fd8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🎮 About multiplayer[/h2][p]Since launch, we’ve received many thoughtful suggestions about adding multiplayer. We’ve taken those seriously and discussed the possibilities at length. After carefully evaluating the impact it would have on the game, we’ve decided to keep Cash Cleaner Simulator a single-player title. [/p][p]We believe this is the right direction for the game and are excited to keep building on that foundation. Thank you for your interest and for being so engaged.[/p][p]We’re also continuing to track your ideas on the [url="https://cashcleanersimulator.featureupvote.com/"]Feedback UpVote Board[/url]. We regularly update the status of suggestions to reflect what’s already been added, what’s currently in development, and what isn’t planned at this time.[/p][p]Feel free to check the board for the latest updates and keep sharing your thoughts with us. We read and consider every submission.[/p][p][/p][h2]👀 More news coming next week[/h2][p]We’ve got a few more announcements lined up for next week. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p][i]– The Cash Cleaner Team [/i]💸[/p][hr][/hr][p][b][i]P.S.[/i][/b] [/p][p]Our friends at [b]Garage Monkeys[/b] just dropped a cool [b]Junkyard Update[/b] for [b]Car Dealer Simulator[/b]! [/p][p]Check it out![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/)"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🔧 QoL Update 1.1.0.154 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey there, Cleaners![/h1][p]:thumb_up_blue: Big thanks to everyone who jumped into the Experimental Branch, tested the changes, and shared their thoughts. Your input helped us catch major bugs early and polish things up.[/p][p]This update improves performance, adds some long-requested settings, and smooths out small but important details to make your daily grind a little more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][h2]🔧 Key Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Major save system improvements[/b] Saving is now much faster and produces smaller files. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New save settings[/b]
You can now choose how often the game autosaves, or turn it off completely. A Manual Save button is also available in the ESC menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Colorblind mode[/b] Added to the Settings menu for better accessibility.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/38387da0208eb67af1d2db20274d5039bb42e03b.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New smartphone app[/b]
Lets you control app notifications and the speed of smartphone animations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/129b66981af09ee3ea1243c9f7014b66e804f9c6.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Random quests with marked money[/b]
These come with special item names and characters to keep things interesting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/2f135fede80eae4653560686691f5240b0c97755.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fake bill deactivation buttons[/b] Added to [b]Money Counters L[/b] and [b]XXL[/b] to make sorting more convenient.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/c3be22e81dfaa4feacd19c22475c0a9256e5959f.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Heavy object pickup animation[/b]
Now you’ll see a short animation when interacting with heavy items, so it’s clear what you’re holding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Other small improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Easier interaction with trash thanks to larger clickable zones[/p][/*][*][p][b]Workbench Sponge[/b] cleans faster[/p][/*][*][p]Scanner hotkey added for both keyboard and gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Updated logic for “find object” quests[/p][/*][*][p]Minor tutorial improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Better trash bag sounds[/p][/*][*][p][b]Darknet[/b] UI touch-ups[/p][/*][*][p]Light switches can now be clicked anywhere, not just on the hand icon[/p][/*][*][p]Holding the amount button in the [b]Dark Market[/b] will now change values continuously[/p][/*][*][p]A small mat has been added next to the workbench[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI tweaks[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed fatal autosave crashes caused by too many objects[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented crashes when changing graphics settings[/p][/*][*][p]Story documents can no longer burn by accident[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where marked money could fall through objects[/p][/*][*][p]Coin visuals are now correct on all graphics settings[/p][/*][*][p]Improved heavy object pickup behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up washing machine visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted story quest order to avoid blockers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]MoneyGun[/b] sound issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a dark visuals glitch near the [b]Workbench[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Resolved visual issues with the [b]Marked Money Compendium[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor localization issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]📚 Check out Community Wiki[/h1][p]Our players are actively building a [url="https://cashcleanersimulator.wiki.gg/"]community wiki[/url] full of helpful info. We're not involved in maintaining it, but we truly appreciate the effort. If you’d like to join the volunteers, head over to the dedicated [b]Wiki chat[/b] in our [url="https://discord.gg/5g3kZ28pG8"]Discord server[/url] and help keep it growing.[/p][p][/p][p]Have an idea or suggestion? Share it on our [url="https://cashcleanersimulator.featureupvote.com/"]Feedback UpVoteBoard[/url]. And if you're not yet part of our cozy and growing community, come hang out with us on [url="https://discord.gg/5g3kZ28pG8"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][i]– The Cash Cleaner Team [/i]💸[/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p]Another Forklift-published game just had its demo updated with a huge batch of improvements based on community feedback. It might be your thing 👇🏻[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720140/Leaf_Blower_Co_Demo/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: [Experimental] Update 1.1.0.131 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h2]🚧 [b]Experimental Branch Update[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We're getting ready for our next major update, and as usual, we're testing it first on the experimental branch.[/p][p]
This version may be unstable and is intended for those who don’t mind a few bumps along the way.[/p][p][b]Switch at your own risk, and don’t forget to back up your save files before trying it out![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]🔧 [b]Key Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Significantly improved saving speed and reduced save file size[/p][p]
⚠️ [b]!!! Please note: when opening your old saves for the first time, they will be converted and become incompatible with the current public game version. notes.title: 🛠️ Roadmap revealed and Update 1.0.4 is live! 🚀
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Mr. Fresh, got something cool for you![/h2]
Thanks to your amazing feedback and involvement, we’ve been able to plan what’s coming next. Today, we’re sharing our development roadmap. It covers [b]Update 1 to 5[/b], which are planned for this year. We don’t have exact dates yet, but everything listed is actively in development. There’s also a [b]Backlog[/b] column with extra ideas we’ll bring into future updates whenever possible.

[b]The full version is available here:[/b] [url=https://trello.com/b/FRYLWWsV/cash-cleaner-sim-roadmap][b]ROADMAP BOARD[/b][/url]

And for a quick overview, here’s a visual summary showing the upcoming updates at a glance:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/b84b1e3c54965b7c01b87db758490ed6c567b95d.png[/img]
[h2]We’re also rolling out 1.0.4 Update:[/h2]
[h3]🔧 Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some storyline blockers (folders now return in some cases, and the lever can no longer be inserted prematurely).
[*] Adjusted the refresh rate of random tasks to reduce the chance of all tasks resetting at once.
[*] Removed some Task Tracker notifications to reduce clutter — let us know if you miss them!
[*] Gold bars can now occasionally appear inside quest-related objects (with a low probability) and be part of quests
[*] Improved graphics on low settings — reduced blue tint for better visual clarity.[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed layout issues with the feedback button in the main menu for some languages.
[*] Resolved incorrect display of yen sign in parts of the UI texts.
[*] Prevented stacking of gold bars and vases with bundles of cash.
[*] Improved the physics of the small case to reduce instances of it flying off unexpectedly.
[/list]
🧽 Thanks again for all your feedback and support. We’re now deep into development on the next big roadmap update, so patches like this will be a bit more occasional for now. Keep the feedback coming and stay fresh!

Let’s keep it growing!
[i]– The Cash Cleaner Team[/i]

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.0.3 is out!
notes.notes:
[h1] :usd_bill: Update 1.0.3 is here! :usd_bill: [/h1]

Thanks so much for all your feedback and bug reports. This update brings a bunch of improvements based on your suggestions. We've focused on polishing mechanics, fixing edge-case bugs, and making the experience smoother overall.

We're also working on a [b]Public Roadmap[/b] to share what’s coming next. 
Stay tuned, lots of cool things ahead!

[h2] 💰 Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]UV lamps[/b] on the [b]Workbench [/b]now function correctly at all times of day and on all graphics settings (no need to wait for night or close the table)
[*] Items you’ve never purchased before are now marked as [b]New[/b] to make it clearer what’s available to buy
[*] Small [b]tutorial [/b]improvements to help new players get started more easily
[*] Minor story tweaks for better consistency and logic
[*] The term [b]Spattered/Splated[/b] has been replaced with [b]Inked[/b] to make terminology more consistent
[*] Localization improved across multiple languages
[/list]
[h2] 🛠️ Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare [b]crash that could occur during item delivery[/b], which sometimes resulted in corrupted save files
[*] Fixed a physics issue where stacks of money could [b]fall through the table[/b]
[*] Fixed various [b]physics glitches [/b]after [b]loading a save[/b] (e.g., floating tables and other objects)
[*] Fixed UV lamps not highlighting [b]marks [/b]correctly
[*] Fixed incorrect rendering of [b]metallic [/b]and [b]gold materials[/b] at night on low graphics settings
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]store items[/b] could get stuck in an infinite restocking loop
[/list]

[h2] :cash_stack: Got more ideas or found a bug?[/h2]

📋 [b]Let us know here:[/b] https://cashcleanersimulator.featureupvote.com/

:thumb_up_blue: Thanks again for being such an awesome part of the community. Your feedback helps shape the future of Cash Cleaner Simulator, and we truly appreciate every suggestion and report!

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.0.2 is out! And we've added Steam Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
[h1] 💸 Update 1.0.2 is here & Steam Cards [/h1]

Hey Cleaners! 
We’ve got a big update for you today, so let’s get right to it.

[h2]🧽 Patch 1.0.2 is live![/h2]

Thanks to your feedback, we've squashed a bunch of bugs, added a few QoL touches, and made some quests a little easier to wrap your head around. Here’s a quick look:

[h3] 💰 New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Active delivery quests[/b] now get a special highlight on your HUD
[*] New [b]feedback button[/b] added to the main menu and system menus so you can reach us faster
[*] Restocking [b]items in the shop[/b] now show a little icon and a progress bar
[/list]
[h3] 💰 Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Wet Case quest[/b] is a bit easier now
[*] Added [b]Trash Bags[/b] tutorial
[*] Added a  [b]switch[/b] handle finding tutorial.
[*] [b]Scanner [/b]notifications now clear when you open the scanner.
[*] Updated [b]quest descriptions[/b] for item deliveries.
[*] Reworded some [b]quest descriptions[/b] for clarity.
[/list]
[h3] 💰 Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tons of localization fixes (still more to come!)
[*] Fixed the big money counter breaking
[*] Fixed lag spikes when placing money into large containers
[*] Classic Sports Bags no longer lose their color after cutting
[*] Fixed how money piles look on low graphics settings
[*] Fixed how marked bills are shown in stacks
[*] Fixed how many Money Counter XXL units you can buy
[*] Fixed quests asking you to put huge items into tiny containers
[*] Fixed field of view randomly resetting
[*] Fixed washer and dryer merging into a cursed appliance monster
[*] Fixed crashes for players whose game would crash immediately after pressing Play
[*] And a few crash-related issues were taken care of too
[/list]
[h3]🔧 We hear you![/h3]
Some of you mentioned there's not really a proper space for UV work during the day. We're improving the workbench so it's better suited for that kind of task. A fix is on the way!

[h2] 🃏 Steam Trading Cards are here![/h2]
[list]
[*] Collect 5 brand-new cards
[*] Craft a badge (regular and foil)
[*] Grab 3 profile backgrounds 
[*] Unlock 5 emoji :usd_bill: :shocked_blue: :cash_stack: :thumb_up_blue: :wow_benji:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/94f61ff014cee469111d05646c28555cb3cdcdea.jpg[/img]

[h2]📣 Over 1,150 reviews?![/h2]
You absolute legends! Your feedback has been insanely helpful — we read it all, we talk about it constantly, and it really helps shape what comes next!

[h2]🗳️ Got ideas? Help shape the game![/h2]
To make things easier, we now have a proper [b]Upvote Board[/b] where you can submit ideas and bug reports, and vote on others too. It helps us figure out what to prioritize first.

[h3]💲 Check it out here:[/h3] https://cashcleanersimulator.featureupvote.com/

[h3]💥10,000+ concurrent players💥[/h3]
We’re still kinda speechless. Seeing so many of you play Cash Cleaner at the same time has been absolutely mind-blowing! :wow_benji:

[h3]💬 The Cash Cleaner Discord is booming[/h3]
Before launch, we had just over 1,000 members. Now we’re closing in on 4,000! The community’s growing fast, and it's full of smart, funny, and helpful people. If you're not in yet, [url=https://discord.gg/5g3kZ28pG8]join us here[/url].

[h3]🛠️ Want even more?[/h3]
We’ve also got a [url=https://discord.gg/vpqqamaEbJ]Forklift Discord[/url], your backstage pass to everything our publisher is working on. Come say hi and see what’s coming next!

Thank you for being part of this amazing journey. You’ve made this launch unforgettable, and we’re just getting started! 💚

Let’s keep it growing!
[i]– The Cash Cleaner Team[/i]
